title: Payer Relations Memo — A New Primary Coverage During a Mobility Equipment Rental
content:
# A New Primary Coverage During a Rental — Mobility Equipment

**Position.** When a different primary coverage starts paying during a Mobility Equipment rental, a new rental period begins under it on the first date of service it covers, months under the earlier coverage do not count, and the new coverage pays only after the class's payer entry requalification (and its own prior authorization where its class requires one). The rental moves only once the new coverage is verified: the new coverage record is in status active. An owned chair is not affected.

## Reading the position

- **Verification.** The status is read from the system's coverage record of the new coverage before the rental moves; only the status active allows it.
- **Count.** Months paid under the earlier coverage do not count in the new rental period.
- **Start.** The new rental period begins on the first date of service the new coverage covers.
- **Requalification.** The new coverage pays only after the class's payer entry requalification, and its own prior authorization where its class requires one.
- **Owned chairs.** An owned chair is not affected.

## Hypothetical illustration

A patient renting a Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) has eight months paid under the earlier coverage when a new primary coverage, verified active, begins covering on 1 October. A new rental period begins on 1 October; the eight earlier months do not count toward it.
